name: a11yfix-monorepo
description: Audit HTML for accessibility violations, generate a minimal patch per violation, and keep only the patches a re-audit proves correct.

scripts.test:sabotage: npm run build && node scripts/test.mjs sabotage
scripts.bench:codemod: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/cli.js bench --corpus ./corpus --mode codemod --report bench/codemod/report.md --out bench/codemod --notes bench/codemod/analysis.md
scripts.bench: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/cli.js bench --corpus ./corpus --mode auto --report report.md --out bench/auto --compare bench/codemod/metrics.json
